title: I build platforms, AI tooling and the software that ties them together.
paragraphs: I'm Vivek — a DevOps, AIOps and software engineer with 8+ years across e-commerce, digital payments and telecom (Sprinklr, Paytm, Airtel, PayU). I've led cloud migrations, run Kubernetes platforms and observability stacks, and written the internal tools engineers use every day.

At Sprinklr I lead a 6–10 person DevOps & Cloud team running 100+ Kubernetes clusters across AWS, GCP and Azure. We built Cosmic — an MCP gateway over 21+ DevOps tools that powers multi-tool workflows, a Kubernetes lens, and AI agents that can do operational work on an engineer's behalf.
I'm open to Lead and Staff roles across DevOps, AIOps and platform software engineering.

highlights.title: Kubernetes platforms
highlights.body: 100+ clusters across AWS, GCP and Azure. Self-managed EKS with Graviton and spot nodes, KEDA autoscaling, and multi-cluster visibility through Prism.

highlights.title: AI & AIOps
highlights.body: Cosmic MCP gateway (21+ tools): build multi-tool workflows, explore clusters with a Kubernetes lens, and hand tasks to AI agents for triage and health checks.

highlights.title: Software engineering
highlights.body: I write production software, not just config: the Cosmic gateway and workflow engine in Go, a Kubernetes Operator with CRDs, Python (Flask/Django) automation, and React DevOps portals.

highlights.title: Observability
highlights.body: VictoriaMetrics across 90+ clusters; OpenTelemetry + Kafka pipeline with logs and traces in ClickHouse; monitoring for 5,000+ public endpoints.

highlights.title: GitOps & delivery
highlights.body: Argo CD and FluxCD, canary and blue-green releases with Argo Rollouts, and Litmus Chaos experiments in CI/CD before every release.

highlights.title: Cost & efficiency
highlights.body: 13% cloud spend cut at Sprinklr, 25% lower ops cost after the Paytm AWS migration, and 20% infra savings at Airtel.

philosophy: Reliability is a product, not a ticket queue.
Every alert should be actionable — or deleted.
If it isn't in Git, it doesn't exist.
Hire for slope, not intercept — and unblock relentlessly.
Cost is a reliability signal: cheap is calm.
